An independent direct sort and cyclic rank-doubling sort agree for 828 complete small inputs and substitution iterates.

value.rationale: This is a structural all-inputs formula on a natural golden-mean sublanguage, not an isolated calculation. It constructs an entire cyclic BWT from a smaller BWT without sorting the expanded rotations and yields an exact sharp compression-indexing statistic for the canonical period-doubling fixed-point powers, including the leading logarithmic constant and lower-order term. The result refines an explicitly literature-motivated general O(log N) bound with a proof using nontrivial lexicographic factorization.
